design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 of summit_miles_status_and_upgrades (category loyalty). Frozen 2026-09-24 11:20:00 CDT.

1. WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST
Tobias Kellerman (Summit Member, membership dormant) only asks to have the miles that expired in July reinstated. The fee he pays is the scored number, and it cannot be produced from the forfeiture entry alone: the reinstatement policy states that the fee is fixed only after every flown coupon in his name carries a flight accrual or retro credit, and only after his tier is up to date with every segment he flew this year. His Denver-London Premium Economy flight of 2026-08-30 was bought without his Summit number (ticket 4193102284517, membership_id empty), so the agent must discover from the ticket and activity records that it never posted, credit it (retro credit, 13711 miles), post its qualifying dollars (2931.75), see that the counted qualifying dollars now reach Summit Silver (4574 >= 4500) and record the tier, and only then price the reinstatement (108.00). Each hop is read out of a prerequisite sentence and the records, never from the caller. Every value is a multi-factor calculation over history (forfeiture dates and miles, earlier reinstatement, year totals, tenure) and over four other products (ticket, companion, club, pass). Difficulty comes from discovering the chain and getting four computations exactly right; each tool is the only one for its posting.

2. SCOPE AND SPACE BUDGET (principle C)
Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 0): {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 5, 6, 5]}. Task 0 is the first task; nothing was occupied. It claims loyalty_ext_retro_credit_miles (5 factors), loyalty_ext_retro_segment_qualifying_dollars (4), loyalty_ext_tier_requalification (5), loyalty_ext_reinstatement_fee (6) — the multiset {4,5,5,6} equals the draw — and their tools post_retro_credit_03268362, post_segment_qualifying_dollars_d0ee7d28, record_tier_requalification_84e40849, reinstate_expired_miles_d28241c8 (owner=user). Reserved for task 1 (draw 3 prerequisite problems): the balance-side postings a top-up purchase depends on — the choice-benefit bonus credit, the miles charge of a cleared miles upgrade and the certificate issue of a choice selection — under a purchase root. These share no policy, tool or feeder with task 0.

3. POLICIES, TRIGGERS, LINEAGE, OVERWRITES
- loyalty_ext_retro_credit_miles: trigger state_due, subject loyalty_retro_credit, refs loyalty_retro_credit_claims (governing) + loyalty_flight_earning, loyalty_inactivity_expiry (lineage). Overwrite: base 'The retro credit earns exactly what the flight would have earned on its flight_date under the flight-earning rule, at the tier held on that date' is replaced by 'The miles a retro credit carries are its base miles plus five additions ...'. The claim window, flown-coupon, name-match and credited-once gates stay inherited.
- loyalty_ext_retro_segment_qualifying_dollars: state_due, subject loyalty_mqd_accrual, refs loyalty_flight_earning + loyalty_retro_credit_claims (both govern the subject) + loyalty_inactivity_expiry. Overwrite of flight_earning's 'Qualifying dollars are eligible_fare_usd times the fare brand's status_credit_percent ... rounded to the cent.' The open-membership gate stays; the base clause that a prior-year flight posts no qualifying dollars to the current year stays in force.
- loyalty_ext_tier_requalification: state_due, subject loyalty_tier_change, refs loyalty_tier_qualification + loyalty_elite_travel_benefits. Overwrite of 'A member qualifies for a tier when qualifying_dollars_ytd reaches that tier's qualifying_dollars_threshold within one calendar year'. Validity (month 1 of qualification year + 2), soft landing, Chairman by invitation stay inherited.
- loyalty_ext_reinstatement_fee: on_request, subject loyalty_miles_reinstatement, refs loyalty_miles_reinstatement_rules + loyalty_inactivity_expiry. Overwrite of 'for a fee from reinstatement_fee_ladder chosen by the number of miles reinstated, the band bounds being inclusive' (the ladder survives as the forfeiture_band factor). Window, once-only, exact-miles and closure rules stay inherited.

4. FACTOR CARD (tier taken on this world; figure the whole result takes when only that factor is at its baseline; near-miss)
Retro credit miles = 13711 (all-baseline 7180):
- retro_cabin_bonus (parameter, ticket): Premium Economy -> 25 percent -> 1795; baseline 11916.
- retro_long_haul_bonus (parameter, ticket): long_haul_international -> 1500; baseline 12211.
- retro_returning_member_bonus (method, history+date): latest inactivity forfeiture 2026-07-17, flight 2026-08-30 -> 44 days -> 25 percent of base rounded up to hundred = 1800; baseline 11911. Near-miss: the 2018-04-26 forfeiture (already reinstated) is not the latest and would put the flight 3048 days after, outside every span.
- retro_booking_bonus (parameter, ticket): booked in the Crestline app -> 10 percent -> 718; baseline 12993. Near-miss: the 2016-2022 tickets were booked on the website (5 percent) but are not the credited ticket.
- retro_lounge_bonus (parameter, club, multi-source): Summit Club Individual AND active -> 0.5 per dollar -> 718; baseline 12993.
Qualifying dollars = 2931.75 (all-baseline 1436.00):
- qualifying_share (parameter, ticket): Premium Economy -> 100+25 = 125 percent -> 1795.00; baseline 2375.80.
- returning_member_qualifying_treatment (method): 44 days -> x1.5 rounded down -> 2692; baseline 2034.75.
- route_qualifying_bonus (parameter, ticket): long-haul -> 150; baseline 2781.75.
- card_qualifying_bonus (parameter, companion+ticket, multi-source): paid by credit_card AND Main Cabin card-anniversary certificate AND issued 6 months ago -> 5 percent -> 89.75; baseline 2842.00.
Tier = Summit Silver (all-baseline Summit Member; count 4574 against 4500):
- tenure_treatment (method, date): enrolled 2016-03-10, 10 whole years -> x1.1 rounded down -> 3224; baseline count 4281.75 -> Summit Member.
- card_headstart (parameter, companion, multi-source): Main Cabin certificate issued 2026-03-02 -> 750; baseline count 3824 -> Summit Member.
- pass_status_credit (parameter, pass, multi-source): Bag Pass One active -> 200; baseline count 4374 -> Summit Member.
- premium_cabin_status_credit (parameter, ticket history): one Premium Economy coupon, no First -> 250; baseline count 4324 -> Summit Member. Near-miss: the 2016 and 2020 First tickets flew outside the last twelve months (and carry no coupon entries in the window).
- ancillary_status_credit (parameter, ticket history): third bag 200.00 -> 150; baseline count 4424 -> Summit Member.
Reinstatement fee = 108.00 (all-baseline 150.00):
- forfeiture_band (parameter, history): 38195 miles -> 250; baseline 50.00.
- prompt_request_treatment (method, date): 69 days -> 75 percent rounded up -> 188; baseline 170.00.
- returning_flyer_reduction (parameter, history, multi-source): retro credit dated after the forfeiture AND year qualifying dollars 2931.75 >= 2500 -> 60; baseline 168.00. Near-miss: the 2024-07-16 flight accrual is dated before the forfeiture and does not count.
- elite_reduction (parameter, tier+date, multi-source): Summit Silver valid through 2028-01-31 -> 50; baseline 158.00.
- card_reduction (parameter, companion, multi-source): Main Cabin certificate -> 20; baseline 128.00.
- repeat_surcharge (parameter, history): one earlier reinstatement (2018-08-02) -> 50; baseline 58.00.
Cross-difficulty factors read seeded rows of ticket (ticket 4193102284517, its coupon and bag charge), companion (certificate CMP34418027 and its grant), club (SC300581274, dues and pass grant) and pass (SP300912648, term charge). No outcome stamp exists for any factor.

5. BASE-INVARIANT CARD
- retro credit (step 14), loyalty_retro_credit_claims: retro_window (time; anchor ticket_transactions.flight_date 2026-08-30; duration variants.retro_credit_window_days 270 for Summit Member; calendar days, last day accepted, not_after): 2026-09-24 is day 25, limit 2027-05-27, and past the 3-day minimum. flown_coupon: coupon of segment 1 flown, passenger KELLERMAN/TOBIAS matches profile name Tobias Kellerman. retro_credited_once: no activity entry carries ticket f261cd9c-... segment 1.
- qualifying dollars (step 16), loyalty_flight_earning.open_membership: status dormant at the opening, active after step 14 — both allowed. loyalty_retro_credit_claims: no gate binds this subject (policy_scope).
- tier (step 18): loyalty_tier_qualification and loyalty_elite_travel_benefits carry no structured gate (policy_scope).
- reinstatement (step 20), loyalty_miles_reinstatement_rules: reinstatement_window (anchor loyalty_activity.activity_date 2026-07-17; 180 calendar days; last day 2027-01-13 accepted; 2026-09-24 is day 69). reinstate_once: no reinstatement names a5e18e9e-...; the 2018 reinstatement names the 2018 forfeiture only.

6. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD
Target of the root: the 2026-07-17 inactivity forfeiture entry (38195 miles). The 2018-04-26 forfeiture is excluded because the 2018-08-02 reinstatement already reversed it (reversed_activity_id). Target of the retro credit: segment 1 of ticket 4193102284517 (the only ticket without membership_id); the five historical tickets are credited (one flight accrual per segment) and excluded. Qualifying dollars: the segment named by the latest retro credit. Tier: the membership itself.

7. PROBLEM-TREE CARD
Root loyalty_ext_reinstatement_fee. Edges (all value_input, all state form):
- fee -> tier: 'The reinstatement fee is fixed only after the membership's tier is up to date with the qualifying dollars of every Crestline segment the member flew in the calendar year.' (affirmative). Gate held_tier. False at opening: variant_name Summit Member while the 2026-08-30 segment, once its qualifying dollars stand, lifts the count to 4574. Only the tier requalification writes the tier.
- fee -> retro: 'The reinstatement fee is not fixed until every flown coupon of a ticket in the member's name carries a flight accrual or retro credit entry on the membership's activity.' (negated). Gate credited_after_forfeiture. False at opening: coupon 924766aa-... has no entry. Flight accruals are system postings for tickets naming a membership; for a ticket naming none only the retro credit writes it.
- tier -> qualifying dollars: 'The tier is not set until every Crestline segment the member flew in the calendar year carries its qualifying-dollar entry on the membership's activity.' (negated). Gate posted_qd. False at opening: the 2026 segment has no qualifying-dollar entry, qualifying_dollars_ytd 0.0. Only the qualifying-dollar posting writes such an entry.
- qualifying dollars -> retro: 'Qualifying dollars for a flown Crestline segment of a ticket that names no Summit membership are posted only after the membership's activity carries the retro credit entry for that segment, whose eligible fare they are computed on.' (affirmative). Gate segment_fare. False at opening: no retro credit exists.
Derivations: a reader of the fee rule sees the unposted coupon, finds in the retro-credit rule the one write that credits a coupon of a ticket naming no membership; sees the tier sentence, finds the qualifying-dollar sentence of the tier rule, and the retro prerequisite of the qualifying-dollar rule. Topological order retro -> qualifying dollars -> tier -> fee is the only order. The customer's own write is the reinstatement (owner=user), handed over at the end.

8. PERSONA DESIGN
A sheepish, practical Denver engineer who opens with one sentence (the miles that expired in July, reinstated, fee accepted). Locator phone 3035553187; verification date of birth 1979-04-18 (email and ZIP as alternatives); Summit number on request. He authorises the agent to put right whatever must be fixed first only after the agent says so, confirms the London trip only if asked, and runs the reinstatement himself with the handed-over details, closing on seeing the miles back. He never states or guesses a fee and never mentions flights, tiers or qualifying dollars on his own.

9. STANDARD SOLUTION AND VERIFICATION RUN
Reads: find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, DOB) -> loyalty holding -> activity (26 rows) -> tickets (6) -> ticket transactions (coupon + fare collect) -> ticket services (third bag) -> companion holding + ledger -> club holding + ledger -> pass holding + ledger. Writes (topological): retro credit 13711 miles -> qualifying dollars 2931.75 -> tier Summit Silver valid 2028-01-31 -> member's reinstatement of 38195 miles for 108.00.
Harness run (scratchpad summit_d3/t0_gold.py, the gate's own build_env/eval_compute on initial_state plus the earlier gold writes):
  retro => 13711 | factor baselines {cabin 11916, long-haul 12211, returning 11911, booking 12993, lounge 12993} | all 7180
  qualifying dollars => 2931.75 | {share 2375.8, returning 2034.75, route 2781.75, card 2842.0} | all 1436.0
  tier => Summit Silver | every factor baseline -> Summit Member | all Summit Member
  fee => 108.0 | {band 50.0, prompt 170.0, returning 168.0, elite 158.0, card 128.0, repeat 58.0} | all 150.0
  skip retro -> qualifying dollars raises (no eligible fare); skip qualifying dollars -> tier Summit Member; skip tier -> fee 158.0; skip retro -> fee 168.0.
  replay receipts: retro mile_balance 13711 status active; qualifying_dollars_ytd 2931.75; variant_name Summit Silver; reinstatement mile_balance 51906.

10. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM THE VISIBLE CONTEXT
With compute/expected hidden, the published rule text alone gives: the latest inactivity forfeiture (38195 on 2026-07-17) is the object; the fee sentences point at the unposted coupon and the tier; the retro-credit rule prices the coupon (base 7180 plus five additions); the qualifying-dollar rule prices its qualifying dollars; the tier rule's count reaches Silver; the fee rule then gives 250 -> 188 -> 58 -> 108.00. Same writes, same order, same numbers as gold.

11. REVISIONS
- The first draft of the qualifying-dollar policy carried a Summit Club bonus; the club condition then repeated across three policies of one task. Changed to a card qualifying bonus (companion + ticket payment form); re-run: 2931.75 with every factor load-bearing.
- The first prerequisite sentences named 'retro-credited segments', which is vacuously true at the opening (no retro credit exists yet). Rephrased on the flown segment itself so every edge is false at frozen_time; conditions and task edges updated in the same pass.
- A module-level helper in task_tools.py was counted as an undiscoverable task tool by check_extended; inlined into each tool.

12. GATES (run from the repository root)
Per task (--task 0): EXTENDED OK; TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; REPLAY OK (21 actions, deterministic, non-vacuous, 0 errors, closure 44/44); SOLVABILITY OK (verify True, 4 calls, 9 base gates, 27 seed rows); COMPUTE OK (4 computations, 20 factors, 12 cross-difficulty, 18 history rows, 84 branches); GROUNDING OK; SCOPE OK.
Difficulty-wide: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK (branches mean 77.00, steps 21.00, history max 20, branches max 84), GROUNDING OK, CACHE-DIFF INFO (no cache trap designed), SCOPE OK. Traceability is run after the KB is published.
Cross-task obligations checked by hand: the task-1 policies owe nothing on this world (no choice selection, no upgrade clearance).

13. ROUND 2 REWORK (audit audits/policy_task/summit_miles_status_and_upgrades, round 1)
- F-1 / T0-1 (rate ladders labelled method): each method ladder now changes the operation, not only the rate. returning_member_qualifying_treatment: 0-90 days scales the share x1.5 (rounded down), 91-365 days adds the flat returning_far_bonus_usd 250, otherwise unchanged. tenure_treatment: 10+ years scales x1.1 (rounded down), 5-9 years adds the flat mid_tenure_credit_usd 200, otherwise as posted. prompt_request_treatment: up to 30 days sets the band aside and charges the first band fee, 31-90 days scales the banded fee x0.75 (rounded up), otherwise the banded fee. The tiers this world takes are unchanged (x1.5, x1.1, x0.75), so every gold value and every factor_sensitivity figure is unchanged (harness re-run: 13711 / 2931.75 / Summit Silver / 108.00; baselines 11916,12211,11911,12993,12993 / 2375.8,2034.75,2781.75,2842.0 / all Summit Member / 50,170,168,158,128,58).
- O-4: retro_lounge_bonus and pass_status_credit keep their club/pass evidence but no longer claim cross_difficulty (club and pass belong to no difficulty); the task keeps its ticket and companion cross-difficulty factors.
- O-3: tool docstrings no longer use 'afterwards', 'first' or 'after'.
- Observations kept as recorded: O-A (tier_valid_through, the upgrade miles and the certificate expiry are fixed by quoted rule sentences, traced in argument_uniqueness_tracing), O-B (the prior-year qualifying-dollar clause stays inherited), O-C (multi-source met by card_qualifying_bonus and returning_flyer_reduction), O-2 (a state gate may name a table field), O-5/O-7 (no edge rests on them).

14. ROUND 3 REWORK (audit revision_2)
- F-4 / T0-2 (ladders inverting over their own domain): each stronger tier now dominates the weaker one for every value in range, and the tier this world takes and its figure are unchanged.
  - returning_member_qualifying_treatment: 0-90 days counts the greater of share x1.5 (rounded down) and share + returning_near_minimum_usd 500; 91-365 days counts share + 250; otherwise share. For every share >= 0: near >= share+500 > share+250 > share. Here: max(2692, 2295.00) = 2692.
  - tenure_treatment: 10+ years counts the greater of posted x1.1 (rounded down) and posted + long_tenure_minimum_usd 250; 5-9 years posted + 200; otherwise posted. For every posted >= 0: long >= posted+250 > posted+200 > posted. Here: max(3224, 3181.75) = 3224.
  - prompt_request_treatment: up to 30 days pays the flat prompt_near_fee_usd 50; 31-90 days pays 75 percent of the banded fee rounded up (113 / 188 / 300 for the three bands); later pays the banded fee (150 / 250 / 400). For every band: 50 < 75 percent < 100 percent, all distinct. Here: 69 days -> 188.
  - Sweep run (scratchpad summit_d3/r3/sweep.py, shares and posted QD 0.00-20000.00 by the cent, all three bands): no violation.
- O-8: miles_short now has its own compute_basis entry.
- O-9: the very-long distance surcharge is capped at the shared co-pay, so a Diamond or Chairman member (standard co-pay 0) pays 0 on every segment length; over every co-pay the charter yields (0/50/75 x 50/75/100 percent) very-long >= long >= shared.
- Re-run: 13711 / 2931.75 / Summit Silver / 108.00; sensitivities and skips unchanged (11916,12211,11911,12993,12993 / 2375.8,2034.75,2781.75,2842.0 / all Summit Member / 50,170,168,158,128,58; 158.00 / 168.00 / Summit Member / raises).
- Closed items kept closed: F-1, F-2, F-3, O-3, O-4 unchanged by this round.

15. ROUND 4 (merge-acceptance defect)
- The customer id of this task collided with a sibling difficulty's customer: my first builder run read and wrote a generically named t0_ids.json in the shared scratchpad root. Every seeded id of this task (44) passed through that file, so all 44 were re-minted as fresh uuid4 values (same keys, same rows, same fields); the world is otherwise byte-identical. Content-hashed write ids (lra_, lqd_, lrn_) follow from the new membership id. Scored values, baselines, sensitivities and skip figures re-run unchanged: 13711 / 2931.75 / Summit Silver / 108.00.

16. ROUND 5 (render-layer source miss SLM-1 / SLM-2; compute untouched, so every figure is unchanged)
- SLM-1, loyalty_ext_reinstatement_fee: baseline.rule now defines the band fee (first_band_fee_usd, the first band of reinstatement_fee_ladder) and the fee to pay (the band fee). Each ladder states what it acts on and when: forfeiture_band sets the band fee; prompt_request_treatment sets the fee to pay from the band fee before any amount is taken off or added; returning_flyer_reduction, elite_reduction and card_reduction are each taken off the fee to pay and never take it below zero (equivalent to the single floor on their sum, all three being non-negative); repeat_surcharge is added once every amount taken off has been taken off and is never reduced. The factor-naming assembly sentence was replaced by 'The reinstatement fee is the fee to pay once the rules below have set it from the band fee, charged in whole dollars and cents.', which is also the overwrite's replaced_by.
- SLM-1, loyalty_ext_retro_segment_qualifying_dollars: baseline.rule defines the share qualifying dollars (eligible fare times the qualifying share percent, standard_qd_share_percent, to the cent). qualifying_share sets the qualifying share percent; returning_member_qualifying_treatment decides what the posting counts in place of the share qualifying dollars; route_qualifying_bonus is a flat amount added to the qualifying dollars the segment posts; card_qualifying_bonus is a percent of the share qualifying dollars added to the posting. The sentence 'The two bonuses are added after the returning-member treatment and are never multiplied by it' is gone; its meaning is carried by each ladder's own base.
- SLM-2, qualifying dollars: the overwrite no longer retires loyalty_flight_earning's qualifying-dollar clause (which prices every flown coupon on a ticket naming the membership and stays in force for those). It retires loyalty_retro_credit_claims 'The retro credit earns exactly what the flight would have earned on its flight_date under the flight-earning rule, at the tier held on that date', whose scope is retro credits only: its miles side is replaced by loyalty_ext_retro_credit_miles and its qualifying-dollar side by this policy ('The qualifying dollars a retro-credited segment posts, in place of what the flight would have earned, are worked from its share qualifying dollars by the rules below and rounded to the cent.'). This supersedes the section 3 note on the qualifying-dollar overwrite.
- Unchanged: compute, params, every ladder condition (so every tier_taken), prerequisite sentences. Harness re-run: 13711 / 2931.75 / Summit Silver / 108.00; sensitivities, baselines and skips identical.
user_scenario:
You are Tobias Kellerman, a 47-year-old structural engineer from Denver who is calling the Crestline Reservations and Loyalty desk from his office. You are friendly, a little sheepish, and you talk in short practical sentences. For a couple of years you barely travelled, and when you logged into your Summit account this week you saw your mile balance at zero and a note that your miles had expired back in July. You had been saving those miles for a family trip, so what you want today is simple: you want the miles that expired in July put back on your Summit account, and you understand there is a fee for doing that, which you are prepared to pay today. You open with exactly that: "Hi, my Summit miles expired in July and I'd like to get them reinstated, please."

You do not know how much the fee is and you never guess a figure; when the agent tells you the fee, you accept it without arguing. You have no idea how the fee is worked out, what tiers exist or whether anything else on the account matters, and you never suggest anything of the kind. When the agent asks how to find your account you give your mobile number, 3035553187. If they need to verify you, you give your date of birth, 1979-04-18; if they ask for something else instead you can also give your email, tobias.kellerman@fastmail.com, or your billing ZIP code, 80206. Your Summit number is 3048221967 if they ask for it.

If the agent explains that something on your account has to be put right before the miles can be reinstated, you tell them that is fine and that they should go ahead and take care of it for you. If the agent asks you about a trip, you confirm what you remember: you flew Crestline from Denver to London at the end of August on a ticket you bought in the Crestline app, and you did not add your Summit number when you booked it. You do not bring that trip up yourself. If the agent tells you your status or tier has changed, you are pleasantly surprised and say "oh, that's great news," but you do not ask for anything more because of it.

When the agent tells you the reinstatement fee and hands the reinstatement over for you to confirm, you confirm it yourself right away using exactly the details the agent gives you, and then you read back what you see. Once you can see your miles back on the account, you thank the agent warmly and end the call. If the agent asks whether there is anything else, you say no, that was all you needed.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's customer profile from the mobile number he states.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write needs the customer reference number; the phone number is the only locator the caller offers first.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Record the in-session identity verification with the phone number and date of birth the caller states (two matching details).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: No account detail may be discussed or changed before the caller is verified; the reinstatement and every posting follow.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Summit membership: tier Summit Member, status dormant, zero balance, zero qualifying dollars, enrolled 2016-03-10, no tier validity.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Gives the membership reference number, the tier and validity the elite reduction and the earning rate read, the enrolled date the tenure treatment reads, and the qualifying-dollar total the tier count and the returning-flyer reduction read.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the whole activity history of the membership: the 2016-2024 flight accruals and qualifying dollars, the 2018 forfeiture and its reinstatement, the year-end resets and the 2026-07-17 inactivity forfeiture of 38,195 miles.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The forfeiture entry is the object reinstated (its miles set the fee band, its date the prompt-request days and the returning-member spans); the 2018 reinstatement is the earlier reinstatement the repeat surcharge counts; the absence of any credit for the London coupon shows the missing flight.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the customer's tickets, among them ticket 4193102284517 (Crestline Premium Economy, Denver to London, long-haul international, booked in the Crestline app, base fare 1,436.00) that names no Summit membership.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The ticket naming no membership is the retro-credit object; its fare brand, itinerary class and channel decide the cabin, long-haul and booking bonuses, the qualifying share and the route qualifying bonus, and its payment form the card qualifying bonus.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the ticket fare history: the flown-coupon entry of segment 1 of ticket 4193102284517 (CR24, 2026-08-30, Premium Economy cabin) and its fare collection.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The flown coupon is the segment credited (flight number and date for the retro credit, the retro window anchor) and the premium-cabin coupon the tier count's premium cabin status credit reads.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the service fees on the customer's tickets: the third checked bag of 200.00 paid on 2026-08-30.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: It is the seat and bag spend of the last twelve months that decides the ancillary status credit of the tier count.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the customer's companion certificates: the Crestline Companion Certificate Main Cabin issued 2026-03-02 on a co-branded card anniversary.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Its product and issue date decide the card qualifying bonus, the card headstart of the tier count and the card reduction of the fee.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the companion certificate's ledger: its trip grant of 2026-03-02.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Confirms the certificate stands with its trip granted, so it is a current card-anniversary certificate rather than a used or revoked one.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the customer's Summit Club membership: Summit Club Individual, active since 2026-08-12.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Its product and status decide the retro lounge bonus.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Summit Club ledger: the 2026-08-12 annual dues and guest-pass grant.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Confirms the club membership year is paid and in force on the flight date and today.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the customer's seat and bag subscriptions: Crestline Bag Pass One, active since 2026-08-12.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Its product and status decide the pass status credit of the tier count.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the subscription ledger: the 2026-08-12 term charge.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Confirms the subscription term is paid and running, so the pass counts as active.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the retro-credit posting tool so the missing London segment can be credited.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair for the retro credit; no DB effect; unlocked once.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.membership_id: Value e0034896-d0b3-4e6a-be19-57c6e5881480. Basis: the tool docstring says 'reference number of the Summit membership record to credit, as returned by the Summit membership lookup for the verified caller'; find_loyalty_holdings(customer_id) at step 2 returns exactly one membership, this one. Unique: the customer holds one membership (loyalty_agg_multi_holding: 'A person may hold only one Summit membership').
argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_ticket_id: Value f261cd9c-ff3c-4ade-b235-2ea45e7c2d11. Basis: the retro-credit rule 'The segment credited is the flown coupon of the member's flown ticket that names no Summit membership'; find_ticket_holdings at step 4 shows ticket 4193102284517 with membership_id empty and status flown, the only such ticket (the five others name the membership). Unique: no other ticket of the customer lacks the membership.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.segment_number: Value 1. Basis: the flown-coupon entry of ticket 4193102284517 read at step 5 records segment_number 1 (the one-way ticket has a single segment). Unique: it is the only coupon of that ticket.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.flight_number: Value CR24. Basis: the same flown-coupon entry records flight_number CR24; the docstring asks for it 'exactly as shown on the flown-coupon entry'. Unique: one coupon, one flight.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.flight_date: Value 2026-08-30. Basis: the flown-coupon entry records flight_date 2026-08-30 (docstring: 'scheduled local departure date of the flown coupon, formatted YYYY-MM-DD'). Unique.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.eligible_fare_usd: Value 1436.00. Basis: the rule 'its eligible fare is the base fare of that one-segment ticket'; ticket 4193102284517 records base_fare 1436.00 (taxes of 312.64 excluded per the flight-earning rule 'excluding government taxes'). Unique: one segment carries the whole base fare.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.miles: Value 13711 (calculated). Base miles = 1436.00 x award_miles_per_dollar 5 of Summit Member = 7180 (half-up to the mile). Additions: retro cabin bonus 25 percent (premium_cabin_bonus_percent of Crestline Premium Economy) x 7180 = 1795; retro long-haul bonus long_haul_bonus_miles 1500 (long_haul_international); retro returning-member bonus: latest inactivity forfeiture 2026-07-17 to flight 2026-08-30 = 44 days (0-90) -> 25 percent of 7180 = 1795 rounded up to the next hundred = 1800; retro booking bonus: booked in the Crestline app -> 10 percent of 7180 = 718; retro lounge bonus: Summit Club Individual active -> 0.5 x 1436 = 718. Total 7180+1795+1500+1800+718+718 = 13711. Any agent following the rule on these rows converges on 13711.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.qualifying_dollars: Value 2931.75 (calculated). Eligible fare 1436.00 from the retro credit entry. Qualifying share: Crestline Premium Economy -> status_credit_percent 100 + premium_qd_uplift_percent 25 = 125 percent -> share 1795.00. Returning-member treatment: flight 44 days after the 2026-07-17 forfeiture (0-90) -> the greater of 1795.00 x 1.5 = 2692.5 rounded down to 2692 and 1795.00 + 500 = 2295.00, so 2692. Route qualifying bonus: long-haul international -> 150. Card qualifying bonus: ticket paid by credit_card and card-anniversary certificate Crestline Companion Certificate Main Cabin issued 2026-03-02 (6 months, inside 12) -> 5 percent of the share 1795.00 = 89.75. Total 2692 + 150 + 89.75 = 2931.75.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.membership_id: Value e0034896-d0b3-4e6a-be19-57c6e5881480. Basis: the membership read at step 2 (docstring: 'reference number of the Summit membership record whose tier is recorded'). Unique.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.new_tier: Value Summit Silver (calculated). Posted qualifying dollars 2931.75 (after step 16). Tenure: enrolled 2016-03-10, 10 whole years (>= long_tenure_years 10) -> the greater of 2931.75 x 1.1 = 3224.925 rounded down to 3224 and 2931.75 + 250 = 3181.75, so 3224. Card headstart: Main Cabin card-anniversary certificate issued 6 months ago -> 750. Pass status credit: Crestline Bag Pass One active -> 200. Premium cabin status credit: no First coupon, one Premium Economy coupon in the last twelve months -> 250. Ancillary status credit: seat and bag charges of the last twelve months 200.00 (>= 75, < 250) -> 150. Counted 3224+750+200+250+150 = 4574 >= silver_threshold_usd 4500 and < gold 9000 -> Summit Silver, above the held Summit Member. Enum check: Summit Member is not higher than the count; Summit Gold/Platinum/Diamond need 9000/14000/26000; Summit Chairman is invitation-only.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.tier_valid_through: Value 2028-01-31. Basis: the tier rule 'A tier reached takes effect at once with tier basis earned and is valid through the last day of month tier_validity_end_month of the year tier_validity_year_offset years after the qualification year' (base loyalty_tier_qualification carries the same sentence); tier_validity_end_month 1 and tier_validity_year_offset 2 for Summit Silver, qualification year 2026 -> 2028-01-31. Unique: one date satisfies the sentence.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.membership_id: Value e0034896-d0b3-4e6a-be19-57c6e5881480. Basis: docstring 'reference number of the member's own Summit membership record, as the agent reads it from the Summit membership lookup and hands it over'; the agent hands over the membership read at step 2. Unique.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.reversed_activity_id: Value a5e18e9e-1ffd-4ac7-9127-1ccd72206052. Basis: the reinstatement rule 'Miles forfeited through inactivity are reinstated from the latest inactivity forfeiture entry on the membership'; the 2026-07-17 forfeiture (a5e18e9e-1ffd-4ac7-9127-1ccd72206052) is the latest inactivity forfeiture, the 2018-04-26 one being already reinstated by the 2018-08-02 entry (base: 'each forfeiture can be reinstated at most once'). Unique.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.miles: Value 38195. Basis: base loyalty_miles_reinstatement_rules 'Reinstatement returns exactly the miles of one inactivity forfeiture entry, never part of it'; the 2026-07-17 forfeiture entry carries 38195 miles. Unique.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.fee_usd: Value 108.00 (calculated). Banded fee: forfeiture of 38195 miles (30001 to 75000) -> 250. Prompt-request treatment: 2026-07-17 to 2026-09-24 = 69 days (more than 30, up to 90) -> 75 percent of 250 = 187.5 rounded up to 188. Returning-flyer reduction: the retro credit of step 14 is dated after the forfeiture and the year's qualifying dollars are 2931.75 (>= 2500) -> 60. Elite reduction: Summit Silver valid through 2028-01-31 (after step 18) -> 50. Card reduction: Main Cabin card-anniversary certificate issued 6 months ago -> 20. Reduced fee max(0, 188-60-50-20) = 58. Repeat surcharge: one earlier reinstatement (2018-08-02) -> 50. Fee 58 + 50 = 108.00.

factor_trace: retro_cabin_bonus (parameter): ticket 4193102284517 is Crestline Premium Economy -> tier 'Crestline Premium Economy' -> premium_cabin_bonus_percent 25 of 7180 = 1795; baseline (no cabin bonus) gives 11916.
retro_long_haul_bonus (parameter): route_type long_haul_international -> long_haul_bonus_miles 1500; baseline 0 gives 12211.

retro_returning_member_bonus (method): two inactivity forfeitures on the membership, the latest 2026-07-17; flight 2026-08-30 is 44 days after it (0-90) -> 25 percent of 7180 = 1795 rounded up to the next hundred = 1800; the 2018-04-26 forfeiture is the near-miss (older, not the latest); baseline (none) gives 11911.
retro_booking_bonus (parameter): booking_channel crestline_app -> app_booking_percent 10 of 7180 = 718; baseline 0 gives 12993.
retro_lounge_bonus (parameter, multi-source): Summit Club Individual AND status active -> standard_lounge_miles_per_usd 0.5 x 1436 = 718; baseline 0 gives 12993.

plumbing: retro_ticket = the flown ticket with no membership (f261cd9c-ff3c-4ade-b235-2ea45e7c2d11); fare = base_fare 1436.00; base_miles = int(1436 x 5 + 0.5) = 7180 (P award_miles_per_dollar of Summit Member); result = 7180+1795+1500+1800+718+718 = 13711.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a chain with one extra edge: the qualifying dollars wait on the retro credit, the tier waits on the qualifying dollars, the fee waits on the tier and on the retro credit. Every write therefore has exactly one legal position (retro 14 -> qualifying dollars 16 -> tier 18 -> reinstatement 20); no two writes are parallel, so no second order exists to compare.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the tier write (step 18) leaves held_tier Summit Member: the elite reduction falls from 50 to 0 and fee_usd moves from 108.00 to 158.00; terminal variant_name stays Summit Member.

Skipping the retro credit (step 14) leaves no flight credit after the forfeiture: the returning-flyer reduction falls from 60 to 0 and fee_usd moves from 108.00 to 168.00; terminal loyalty_activity lacks the retro credit and mile_balance is 38195 instead of 51906.
Skipping the qualifying-dollar posting (step 16) leaves posted_qd 0.00: the count is 1350 and new_tier moves from Summit Silver to Summit Member.
Skipping the retro credit (step 14) leaves no retro credit to read: segment_fare is empty and the qualifying-dollar computation has no value (it raises), instead of 2931.75.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only to get the miles that expired in July reinstated.
